video_title: Collin Gillespie Training Camp Media Availability | 10-1-26

quotes.speaker: Collin Gillespie
quotes.summary_phrase: Collin Gillespie on his personal shooting and free throw routine
quotes.excerpt: The shooting stuff is my design. I've done that since I've been in Denver.
quotes.quote: The shooting stuff is my design. I've done that since I've been in Denver. And then the free throw thing, I've always done 10 in a row and then finish with two swishes. And then we just started doing the game as a competitive way to, if I got to make a certain type of free throw. I think I'm the best free throw misser in the league, so, like, purposely, I know how to miss free throws.
quotes.social_post: Collin Gillespie shares his unique free throw routine, joking that he is the best free throw misser in the league because he knows how to miss them on purpose.

quotes.speaker: Collin Gillespie
quotes.summary_phrase: Collin Gillespie on the importance of offensive rebounding and tagging
quotes.excerpt: It's part of our rules with the whole tagging on offensive rebound and stuff like that.
quotes.quote: It's part of our rules with the whole tagging on offensive rebound and stuff like that, being able to pick up full on makes or misses to slow the other team down. It's something that I pride myself on, something that you don't do a lot of in the summertime, so this is the time to really get back to it and start focusing on it again.
quotes.social_post: Collin Gillespie says he prides himself on the defensive tagging rules the Suns are implementing, noting that training camp is the time to get back to focusing on those habits.

quotes.speaker: Collin Gillespie
quotes.summary_phrase: Collin Gillespie on his two-man chemistry with Bol Bol
quotes.excerpt: I think they're very different players. I think Bol is more mobile around the perimeter.
quotes.quote: I think they're very different players. I think Bol is more mobile around the perimeter, so it's easier. We've played with each other for a while, so we kind of have that two-man chemistry or whatever you want to call it, where we kind of know what to expect. And just now, me and Bol are working on that. He's working on that with other guys as well, when to stick screens, when to get out early and be able to put pressure on the rim because he's definitely a lob threat at a high level.
quotes.social_post: Collin Gillespie discusses his two-man chemistry with Bol Bol, highlighting Bol's mobility and his ability to act as a high-level lob threat.

quotes.speaker: Collin Gillespie
quotes.summary_phrase: Collin Gillespie on Bol Bol's potential and development
quotes.excerpt: Bol is a sponge, obviously. He's a really good young guy that has a lot of potential.
quotes.quote: Bol is a sponge, obviously. He's a really good young guy that has a lot of potential, a lot of talent. He's a bull, so when he catches the ball, you got to be ready to take a bump, take a hit. I think it's just about him learning the speed of the game, obviously picking his spots. He's not known as a shooter, right? He can't hide that. So, what are other ways that you can impact the game?
quotes.social_post: Collin Gillespie on Bol Bol's development: He is a sponge with a lot of talent, but he needs to focus on learning the speed of the game and finding ways to impact the floor beyond his shooting.

quotes.speaker: Collin Gillespie
quotes.summary_phrase: Collin Gillespie on Bol Bol's motivational tactics
quotes.excerpt: It's like a scab. He just keeps picking at it and then they start bleeding everywhere.
quotes.quote: It's like a scab. He just keeps picking at it and then they start bleeding everywhere. Sometimes he doesn't do a great job of picking his moments because it'll be like, all right, I'm fed up with hearing this. But he means well and he does it out of the goodness of his heart. He's trying to really help somebody, so it'll be interesting for Bol. Hopefully he enjoys it.
quotes.social_post: Collin Gillespie describes Bol Bol's motivational style as being like a scab that he keeps picking at, noting that while Bol means well, he does not always pick the right moments to offer advice.
